dataList.content:
We quickly moved our conversation into the hideout after defeating the Yurodiviye members.
在制服了圣愚成员后，我们避开周围人的目光，悄悄进入了据点。
dataList.place:
Yurodiviye Hideout
圣愚 秘密据点

dataList.content:
Gah...!
呃……

Surrender and confess.
投降，然后老实交代吧。

Starting to run low on patience. Might kill you soon.
我那让你活下去的耐心可已经到极限了。

<Ah, no... Looks like Ryōshū's getting tired of playing detective...>
<糟糕……看来良秀也对侦探游戏失去兴趣了……>

We've surrendered already. Not sure what you want us to confess, either. What, would you like for us to confess that we're the Yurodiviye or something?
我们已经投降了。但不明白你到底要我们交代些什么。难道要我们坦白自己是圣愚吗？

We hesitated, unsure if he really was clueless or not. That's when Rodya confidently strode forward and pointed an accusatory finger at the Yurodiviye Captain.
正当我们在犹豫他是否真的什么都不知道的时候，罗佳却大摇大摆地走上前来，向圣愚队长伸出了食指。

Right, questioning time! You've always hated this Nest's state of affairs, am I right?
来，你们一直很讨厌这座巢吧？

… Must you really ask?
……这是理所当然的。

You like inventing stuff and not registering them to the Tech Agency, don'tcha?
还制造了没有在技术局登记的发明……是吧？

Again... must you really inquire about something you could discern simply by looking around?
那是因为……你看看这附近不就知道了吗？

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
Ooh, mind if I take a gander at these inventions?
嗯，我可以看看这些发明吗？

Wait, don't just go around touching—
等等……你别随便乱碰……

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
Hm, I see. This hedgehog toy is a time bomb disguised as a stuffie. It scans the palm as soon as it enters within a certain proximity range, and if it doesn't recognize the palm as an authorized individual's, it'll shoot out its spines to penetrate the intruder.
哦，这个刺猬玩具，其实是炸弹啊？会对接近的人进行扫描，若是未经许可的人，就会伸出刺……过一段时间，就会朝四面八方发射那些刺。

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
But you've screwed the parts too tightly down here. You'll do well to remember that mechanical engineering isn't all about tightening the screws as hard as you can; sometimes you need a slightly loose screw or two to make things fit better. And another thing: if I were you, I would've made the spine holes hexagon-shaped, not circular.
但是这下面的螺丝拧得太紧了。盲目地拧紧螺丝并不一定更好。如果是我的话，就不会把刺孔做成圆形，而是做成六边形呢？

... You could tell all that from a quick look? You are certainly no common employee.
……摸一下就知道那么多？你确实不是普通的员工。

Either way, most of those are experiments, incomplete products. In truth...
反正这些大多是有很多不足之处的试验作品。其实……

... In truth, ya like making more dangerous, destructive inventions too, right?
你还有更危险、更具破坏性的发明，是不是？

You really are a persistent one, aren't you? What are you getting at?
可真固执啊。你想说什么？

And I'm sure these violent inventions eventually led to something that can completely rip someone's time away.
然后发明出了能完全夺走时间的发明……

Wait, I'm... what?
什么……什么？

The culprit behind 'The Case of Timekilling Time'...
时间杀人时间的犯人。

... it's you guys, right?
就是你们吧？

It's what you do, isn't it? Ya see something that rubs ya the wrong way, so you go ahead and smash it to bits.
就算用过激一点的手段，你们也要把不合心意的东西砸个稀巴烂，不是吗？

That's a bit of a logical leap, isn't it? Who do you think we Yurodiviye are?
逻辑跳跃得有点过分了。你到底把我们圣愚当成什么了？

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
Sounds like this pal of yours in the Yurodiviye really messed up big time in the past, hmm? Did he do something drastically violent?
看样子，你的朋友以前好像惹出过很多事吧？

No, Sonya... he...
……不，索尼亚他……

He always knew how to say the right things. Things to get people to agree with him, to convince them to join his cause.
他总是擅长说些冠冕堂皇的话。很多人都对他的口才表示赞赏与认同。

His words filled me with this... confidence. That we could really change the world, that it really was as effortless as letting candy slowly melt away in my mouth.
因为听着他的话，会感觉改变一切就像在嘴里融化糖果一样简单。

But... what could he possibly do to change the world? He doesn't even do anything, not like these guys. I bet the T Corp. Yurodiviye are nothing more than knockoffs who just found themselves inspired by stories coming out of J Corp. Or—
但是……他能改变什么呢？索尼亚行动不像他们那么积极。T公司的圣愚估计只是听了J公司的传闻，套用了他们的名号……

It's absolutely baffling how you failed to correctly deduce a single thing. No, we're not 'knockoffs'. Besides, the Saint has already brought many changes to this world. Changes that you mere detectives can't even dream of.
从刚开始的推理就没有一个正确的……我们并不是冒牌货。还有……圣者大人已经给这个世界带来了许多改变。多到像你这样的一介侦探做梦也想象不到的地步。

The Saint...?
圣者……？

Indeed. Saint Sonya was the one who really sparked the fire of the Yurodiviye in every Nest. Well, that isn't the only reason they call him the Saint, but that's besides the point.
是的，索尼亚大人建立了把圣愚扩张到所有的巢这样伟大的功勋。虽然他被称为圣者不仅仅是因为这个原因。

Yurodiviye... in every Nest...? Sonya did that?
圣愚……所有的巢？索尼亚？

Since you claim to be Saint Sonya's friend, allow me to say it in no uncertain terms. The Yurodiviye has nothing to do with your case.
既然是索尼亚大人的朋友，那我就说得更清楚一些。我们圣愚和那些案件没有关系。

Sonya... he...
索尼亚……

Hah, are we supposed to take you at your word?
哈，我们凭什么相信你说的是实话？

First, we don't have this 'time killing' technology. We can steal time or timepieces, but it's practically impossible to kill time. Making something so absurd would surely catch the Tech Agency's attention.
首先，我们并没有“杀死时间”这么厉害的发明。我们可以偷走时间、夺取钟表，但杀死时间从常理来讲是不可能的。制造那样荒谬的东西一定会被技术局登门拜访。

And that is trouble that I am not willing to invite.
我不想引起那样的骚乱。

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
Why? You've certainly been causing a ruckus here. Isn't that what the Yurodiviye wants? Chaos?
为什么？现在也有不少人在巢里闹事。圣愚不是想要更多的骚乱吗？

Please, don't compare us to the likes of Backstreets gangs. Though there are those among us who want that chaos, of course.
请不要把我们当成后巷黑帮。虽然我们当中确实也有一部分人想要制造那样的骚乱。

One of our former members insisted that we must take the abundance of time in T Corp. for ourselves and have our comrades divide it equally among us.
我们曾经的一位成员主张要夺走T公司剩余的时间，平等地分配给我们的同伴们。

But such drastic action would also hurt the have-nots, those who do not deserve such pain. So we must adhere to the Saint's teachings. To truly tear out the throats of the rich, we must wait for the right moment.
但这样也会给一无所有的人带来伤害。所以我们要遵从圣者大人的话，等待撕开富人喉咙的完美时机。

The right moment... haah, so it really was Sonya...
完美的时机……哈，真的是索尼亚传播出去的啊……

… So, I've been wondering. Are you really the Saint's friend?
……我从刚才开始就在想，你真的是圣者大人的朋友吗？

Of course she is~ He even invited her to join his journey!
当然是啦~甚至是他邀请她加入的对吧？

<Why don't we leave for now? We can always come back here once we uncover more evidence.>
<总之先回去吧？等找到证据之后再来……>

Dante says "let's leave for now".
但丁经理说要先回去。

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
Hm? Are we not arresting them? Didn't one of you give me a whole lecture about how it's my job to arrest them?
嗯？我们不逮捕他们吗？你们中有人不是刚刚还吵着说逮捕他们是我的职责吗？

Rodya ignored the Assistant's question and turned around to leave the hideout, wearing a dark expression—something I had never seen from her before. The Assistant shrugged, and we were about to leave the hideout as well... but the Yurodiviye Captain stopped us.
罗佳带着无比忧郁的表情，没有回答助手的问题就走了出去。就在耸了耸肩的助手和其他罪人也要跟着出去的时候，圣愚队长叫住了我们。

Wait. If you really are a friend of the Saint, then I can't let you leave without giving you some advice as the more experienced detective. I was able to establish a few things from this conversation, so allow me to share them with you.
等等。既然是圣者大人的朋友，作为侦探前辈，我可以给你几点建议。正好我想到了几件事。

dataList.title:
T Corp.
T公司
dataList.content:
Ohh~ Right! You dabble in detective work from time to time as well, yes? Is this a common thing that you Yurodiviye get up to?
啊~对了，你们偶尔也会做侦探工作来着？所有的圣愚都是这样吗？

No, only the Yurodiviye branch in District 20 do. Anyway, if I were you... I would start by looking for a common thread that ties all victims together. Find out what they have in common.
不，只有20区的圣愚支部这样做……不管怎样，如果是我的话，我会先从寻找受害者们的共同点开始。

... Why?
那是……为什么？

The T Corp. Collections Agency knows everything about time. Where it comes from, where it goes. But not with this case.
T公司征收厅知道时间从哪里流出，又流向哪里。但这次不知道，所以抓不到犯人。

But... if they know everything about comings and goings of time, how are you avoiding their eyes?
但他们不是也没抓到圣愚的人吗？

... Not all of us do. I can't tell you more, however. Just know that we have an ace up our sleeve that lets us continue our guerilla activities in this Nest.
……被抓的人也很多。除此之外就是秘密了。你只需要知道，我们有能让自己继续在巢里活动的秘密手段就是了。

Anyways... does it not strike you as odd that, for someone with such impressive technology that can quite literally rip away time without a trace, the killer seems unusually passive?
总之，你不觉得那人明明有可以不留痕迹地夺取时间的手段，却消极得不可思议吗？

This tells me that there is a condition they must first meet to use their powers. Another possibility is that they have a certain creed, or a belief system that they follow... but ideologically motivated culprits usually leave behind more obvious evidence that points to their beliefs.
我认为肯定是有条件的。虽然也可能是其抱持着某种信念，但那种确信犯会留下更明显的痕迹。

Ooh... I think that adds up nicely! Wanna join our squad of ace detectives?
哦……听起来好像确实如此。你要加入我们的侦探团吗？

... Who the hell hired this bumbling team of amateur detective wannabes?
……这些愚蠢的侦探到底是谁雇用的？

Haah... never mind. Now, would you kindly leave this place?
唉，算了吧。你们现在可以出去了吗？

<Well, we now know where the Yurodiviye are. We can always come back here if we ever need anything else.>
<……我们已经掌握了据点的位置，以后再来吧。>
